office: the Philippine Statistics Authority (PhilSys registration centres)

routes.label: registration in person at a PhilSys registration centre

note: For citizens. The Philippine Identification System Act (Republic Act 11055), section 6(c)(3), read on the Supreme Court's E-Library (2026-11-03): the first PhilID and its renewal are free to a citizen; a replacement card carries a standard fee the Act doesn't set (not modelled). The card's term and the time to delivery aren't in the Act, and the PSA's and PhilSys's own pages refused or were down, so both are null and the player is told. LawPhil's copy, which the entry stood on until then, says the same.

sources.title: Supreme Court of the Philippines E-Library, Republic Act No. 11055, An Act Establishing the Philippine Identification System (August 6, 2018), section 6(c)(3)
sources.said: (3) Fees. - The initial application and issuance as well as the renewal of the PhilID for citizens shall be free of charge. A standard fee shall be collected by the issuing agency from resident aliens and on the reissuance of a replacement card
